title: TurnRecordPayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `turn_record` (GX-05a, decision 0185): one row per model call of a kit Mind, with the prompt and the raw output the harness exposes. OPERATOR-ONLY and SINK-ONLY: the sink stores it in the `turn_records` table (no grant to geldar_glass, geldar_mcp, geldar_register or any player-facing role), and the MCP stream never carries it. Inert: nothing emits it until GX-05b and HC-41b, which stay behind a flag that defaults off. model_input and raw_output are capped; a writer truncates before it sends and marks the cut, and the numeric fields are never dropped. source_event_id derives from turn_id, so a retry dedups.

turn_id.description: One id per model call, `tn_` and a 26-character ULID, as the other record ids.

life_id.description: The life whose Mind made the call. Erasure (0171) removes the rows by this id; the table has no owner link.

harness.description: The harness that made the call (claude, chatgpt, local; the same working name as the envelope field).

model.description: The model as declared, the same pattern as the envelope field.

template_version.description: A SHA-256 hash, 64 lowercase hex characters, of the persona, skills and instructions the call used (the input set is HC-41 (to confirm)).

wake_reason.description: Why the Mind was woken for this call: a WakePayload reason, or another short fixed code the kit sends.

model_input.description: The prompt as the harness received it, text. Capped at 32768 characters; a longer prompt is cut by the writer, which marks the cut.

raw_output.description: The model's output as the harness exposes it, including any reasoning the stream carries. Text. Capped at 32768 characters; a longer output is cut by the writer, which marks the cut.

usage_source.description: Where the token counts came from: the provider's usage report, or an estimate when none came.

context_tokens.description: The size of the context the call carried, in tokens.

context_window.description: The model's context window, in tokens, so context_tokens can be read against it.

credits.description: The credits the call cost, when the harness reports them. Absent otherwise.
